title: Cool objects using the fridge before placing them
description: Use this when a task requires cooling an object, such as a pan, before moving it to a destination.
content: To cool an object, first take the object, then go to the fridge and use the "cool [object] with [fridge]" action. Ensure the fridge is open before attempting to cool the object.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some pan and put it in countertop.

title: Clean objects at a sinkbasin before placing them when a clean state is required
description: Use this when the task requires placing a clean version of an object and the object's current state is uncertain or dirty.
content: To make an object clean, take it to a sinkbasin and use the clean action with the sinkbasin. After cleaning, verify the object is still in your inventory before moving it to the destination.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a clean soapbar in shelf.

title: Search systematically through storage furniture when looking for a target object
description: Use this when the target object is not immediately visible and you need to locate it in a room.
content: When searching for an object like a plate, check all plausible storage locations such as cabinets, drawers, and the fridge. Open closed containers before examining them, since objects inside are only visible after opening.

source.task_query: Your task is to: heat some plate and put it in sidetable.

title: Clean objects at a sink basin before placing them
description: Use when a task requires cleaning an object before storing it.
content: After picking up the object to be cleaned, go to a sink basin and use the clean action with the sink basin. The sink basin does not need to visibly contain anything for the cleaning action to succeed.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some soapbar and put it in cabinet.

title: Search common furniture surfaces when looking for newspapers
description: Use this when searching for newspapers or similar reading materials in a living room environment.
content: Newspapers are often found on sofas or other seating furniture rather than shelves or drawers. When searching for newspapers, prioritize checking sofas, armchairs, and similar surfaces before exploring less likely locations like shelves and drawers.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two newspaper and put them in coffeetable.

title: Transport objects one at a time between locations
description: Use when multiple objects need to be moved from one location to another.
content: When moving multiple objects to a destination, pick up one object, carry it to the destination, place it there, then return to the source location to retrieve the next object.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two alarmclock in desk.

title: Handle multiple identical items by temporarily placing held items back
description: Use this when you need to pick up multiple items of the same type but cannot hold more than one at a time.
content: If you are already carrying one item and need to pick up another of the same type, first move the held item back to a surface to free your hands. Then pick up the second item, transport it to the destination, and return for the first item.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two newspaper and put them in coffeetable.

title: Locate multiple target objects across different surfaces
description: Use when a task requires collecting multiple instances of the same object type.
content: When a task asks for multiple identical objects, do not assume they are in the same location. Search different furniture surfaces one by one, picking up each target object as you find it before moving to the next location.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two keychain in drawer.

title: Heat objects with the microwave only after removing them from the microwave
description: Use this when attempting to heat an object with a microwave and the action does not work while the object is inside.
content: If heating an object inside a microwave fails, take the object out of the microwave first, then use the heat action while holding it. The heating action succeeds when the object is in your inventory rather than inside the appliance.

source.task_query: Your task is to: heat some plate and put it in sidetable.

title: Move objects to a destination only when at the destination location
description: Use this when attempting to place an object into a container or appliance.
content: The move action only succeeds when the agent is at the same location as the destination container. If the move action fails, navigate to the destination first, then perform the move action.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a hot apple in fridge.

title: Retry failed actions before abandoning them
description: Use when an action like taking or opening fails with "Nothing happens" or a blocked message.
content: If a take or open action fails, retry the same action multiple times because transient failures can occur. For example, a drawer handle may stick on the first attempt but open on the second, and a take action may succeed after several retries.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Search multiple locations for target objects
description: Use when a task requires finding multiple instances of an object and the first location does not contain enough items.
content: When searching for multiple objects, systematically visit different room locations such as toilets, countertops, and hangers rather than repeatedly checking the same empty location. Objects of the same type are often distributed across different surfaces in the environment.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.
